The creature draws breath through the same side of its jaw. This time, everyone knows what comes next.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One visible creature within 6 squares whose attack you witnessed this scene.
Type
Skill / Defense / Utility

Choose the witnessed attack. Learn its range and defense attribute. You and every ally within 3 squares who hears your explanation gain 1 Boon to the next defense against that attack before the start of your next turn.
